entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
I need to return a VeloBand Pulse. Let's get this done.
Thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Diana. I can help you with that. Can I start with your name and order number, please?

Thank you, Michael. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered 19 days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's a technical fault. The heart rate tracking is a joke. This thing is absolute garbage.

I'm very sorry to hear you're having trouble with it. Our technical support team is excellent and can usually resolve these sensor issues right over the phone. Would you be open to me transferring you?
No. I don't have time for a tech support runaround. I just want my money back. I bought a product that doesn't work, and I want a refund.
I understand your frustration, Michael. I just need to verify the return policy for this item. Please hold for one moment.
Okay, thank you for your patience. I've checked our system, and it looks like you are well within the 90-day return window.
Great. So you can process the return?

Yes, I can. I've just approved the return in our system. I'm sending you an email with a prepaid shipping label right now. You should see it in your inbox shortly. Once our warehouse receives the item, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method.
Perfect. Is there anything else I can help you with today, Michael?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
